dct_description_sm:
Polygon Feature.
Coordinate System: NAD_1983_UTM_Zone_17N.
This layer has information related to City of Barrie easements. Relevant fields include easement type, registration date, and easement purpose.  Note private easements are not included in the data.

The City of Barrie is situated in the heart of Central Ontario, a premier waterfront community on Lake Simcoe, conveniently located an hour north of Toronto.  Visit barrie.ca for more information or contact Service Barrie at 705-726-4242 or ServiceBarrie@barrie.ca
